extra.reason: src/sermon package skeleton with pipeline/web/jobs/store, pyproject with verified pins, and an import-hygiene test that catches sys.path routes into experiments/ as well as static imports

pytest-bdd collects all 604 scenarios with no hand-maintained list; 17 spec tags registered as marks; validate_spec wired in as a test. Two review rounds closed nine execution-verified routes by which the suite could go green while the spec was silenced, hollowed or partly unread — spec size, step count (1898), executed-vs-skipped counts, deferral level, recursive step discovery, and hooks refused in step modules are each pinned by a guard test.

SQLite store for the seven DOMAIN.md entities: generated DDL, 12 closed sets derived from README.md's own tables with CHECK enforcement, ordered child collections, data-root-relative paths guarded on write and resolvable on read. Review found a data-integrity defect — saves() never rolled back, so a refused row became durable on the next successful write — plus five Important findings; all fixed and pinned by regression tests that assert a refusal left no row, checked through a second connection.

Segment.distribution_confirmed records per-approval consent as a tri-state: null never asked, false declined, true confirmed. Verified unlosable — all three round-trip identity-preserved and a CHECK refuses anything else through raw SQL.

Segment.publication_date and label, both nullable because required is a condition of publishing. The DDL generator gained a real date type rather than reusing datetime, since the filename convention is a calendar date.

Notification modelled with every field its feature file's table names, state closed on the four verbatim values, subject as recording_id plus nullable segment_id following Artifact and Job. Delivery concerns disclosed in a Not stored note rather than silently omitted.
Block.speaker_profile_ids became Block.speaker_matches carrying a similarity per link. Named similarity rather than confidence because this model reserves confidence for a derived high/medium/low.
DOMAIN.md's Recording state count corrected to ten; Block types verified genuinely eleven. A new drift test parses the stated count out of the field row, which the previous test never checked.

Proposal is 1:N with a supersession chain. Decided on the live requirement rather than the archival one: showing a new machine proposal beside a reviewer's edit needs two Proposals for one Segment simultaneously, which no 1:1 can hold. Boundaries deliberately stay on the Segment; the consequence and the missing processing log are both filed.

LogEntry models the processing log as one entity: state transitions, job attempts, human actions and boundary sets in one ordered table, with correlation_id NOT NULL so an entry can be tied to the application logs. One table rather than three because the spec expands one log and calls its unit an entry, and because one query then returns the whole log in time order.

Boundary history lives on the log, so a superseded Proposal gets its cuts back via proposal_id and a reviewer's adjustment (which has no Proposal) sits in the same ordered history. Segment.proposed_punch_in was dropped rather than kept: it duplicated the machine's suggestion two rows above the model's own rule against a second source of truth, and nothing could have detected the drift.

Proposal.punch_in_candidates carries Candidate(timecode, considered_because). Deliberately not the Evidence shape: the scenario gives exactly two facts, Evidence.implies would be empty, and reusing it would make every evidence entry look like a jumpable boundary when most are not. Punch-in only, since punch-out has no such scenario.

Both halves of the spec audited exhaustively: 460 scenarios across all 34 feature files, 181 interface/operations/notifications and 279 ingestion/analysis/processing. Result: 21 certain gaps and 19 arguable, all filed. Five entities are unmodelled (skipped object keys, events belonging to no Recording, the reviewer, the accuracy corpus, retained suite results); Segment has no span distinct from its punch points, which makes a validation rule three interface scenarios depend on unimplementable; and five DOMAIN.md statements are stale or falsified by scenarios. Seven feature files were confirmed fully covered by the current model.

Segment carries span_start_seconds/span_end_seconds, required because every Segment the spec creates has both ends. Two invariants deliberately deferred rather than dropped: punch points inside the span (sp-6kh, amended to name it) and overlap rejection on extension, which compares two rows (sp-wpw). segment_proposal.feature:206 resolved as not a contradiction — a merge and a hand-drawn Segment start coincident; a proposed Segment's span is detected and normally wider.
Segment.summary, distinct from Notification.summary which is composed delivery text.

Recording carries integrated loudness, true peak and loudness range with units in the field names, so the render's normalization inputs cannot be confused with dynamic_range_db or with the render's own target.

Recording carries ordered per-channel levels, the channel-or-mix decision, and whether a human answered it — the render blocks on that answer so it cannot be recomputed. mono_source is open text, since the scenarios name one value and declare no vocabulary; a closed set would have been invented spec.
ARTIFACT_KINDS gains envelope, the first stage's output that every later stage re-reads and that the do-not-recompute promise depends on.

Segment.confirmed_speaker_profile_id with a foreign key, so a human's correction of who preached survives a re-analysis that re-ranks the machine's similarity scores. distribution_confirmed was the consent half; this is the identity half.

SkippedObject keyed on the object key, with a CHECK-closed reason taken verbatim from the spec's own Examples table. Keyed on the key rather than a generated id because three of the four reasons describe keys no Recording row can exist for, and because a scheduled re-scan should correct its row rather than append one per scan. Reviewer attacked and approved the design: the scenarios name a set of objects and record the reason singular, so a timestamp would be a field no scenario forces.

Discovery: one entity for scans and webhook receipts, since the health view renders them as one thing with one shared attribute. No Alert entity — the scenarios give an alert no fields of its own, so Notification.recording_id became nullable instead. Review proved that relaxation had turned an enforced guarantee into caller discipline; a new Presence primitive restores it in the schema and also forbids a webhook carrying a scan-only failure or a failed scan reporting discoveries.

Recording.warnings[] holds seven named conditions from a closed set, ordered. Closed because later behaviour reads the strings — the render gates on one and the detail view explains another specifically — unlike Notification.kind and LogEntry.kind, which nothing branches on. Four conditions excluded as derivable from the emptiness metrics and duration.
source clipping detected is a value in Recording.warnings[] rather than its own field; the Segment-side 'source was clipped' derives from it.

Segment.warnings[] holds five named conditions. Review found the original three were short by two: 'no clean cut point found at punch-in' and its punch-out twin are quoted in the Gherkin and are NOT derivable from the Proposal's hard difficulty, which also grades noise near the cut and music under the first words.

source no longer available is a Recording warning, and the Segment side is a query over it rather than a second flag. No state transition accompanies it — a reviewed Recording stays reviewed, which the scenario implies by naming no transition.
Recording.capture_device, nullable because webhook_notification.feature has a Recording created without a device identity.

Decided NOT to store the probed codec: the object key already names it and README records container/codec as a project-wide constant. Pinned by a test that fails if anyone adds the field, and the decision is recorded in DOMAIN.md so it reads as considered rather than overlooked.
Block.possibly_multiple_types, which the reviewer's split affordance needs something to key on; evidence[] is free text and cannot carry the assertion.

Recording.started_at_source, required and closed to key/last_modified, plus sidecar_present. Required with no default because a null reading as 'probably the key' is the same silent poisoning of the 10:50-10:57 confidence band that the bead exists to prevent. The sidecar's and webhook's recorded_at are not further values: each carries the recorded time the key already gives.

Configuration is a frozen value built from an injected mapping — six variables, no defaults, an unset one named in the error. The HTTP-only boundary is enforced at construction (ssh://, file:// and bare hosts refused), an unreachable endpoint is named rather than blamed on the model, and S3 credentials cannot reach a repr, an f-string or a log line. No test makes a network call.
package-data ships templates and client assets, proved by building a wheel before and after rather than by asserting the declaration exists; recursive globs because a flat one drops nested partials.

experiments/baseline.py plus a committed 468 KB snapshot fingerprinting 34 MB of derived data: 232 scored rows whole, 181 block files as canonical digests plus the values rederive.py rewrites, transcripts and diarization as digests. One command reports drift; verified independently strict on value (1 ms change exits 1, naming file, field and digest) and quiet on representation (all 181 files reformatted, exits 0). Nothing re-derived, nothing scored, held-out budget untouched, no existing experiments file modified.

The validated pipeline is extracted into src/sermon/pipeline: seven modules moved whole, the render chain and ollama client lifted out of their CLI drivers. Behaviour preservation verified independently two ways — AST comparison showing every moved function body byte-identical, and re-deriving all 181 stored block files through the pre-move code rebuilt in isolation for zero differences. Not a pure rename: three modules resolved data paths from __file__, so a verbatim move would have silently repointed them at a directory that does not exist; those roots are injected now, and fail loudly naming module and setting. Review also fixed a broken spike entry point, six frozen modules reaching undefended roots, and a static guard a comment could satisfy.

Verdict: nothing drifted. Data instrument exit 0, the boundary fingerprint reproduces all 181 stored block files, and a new behavioural net closes the gap the move's review found — seven of nine moved modules had no guard at all. Sixteen mutations are caught, fifteen behaviourally rather than by a value pin; verified independently by mutating blocks.GAP_S, rules.TEACH_MIN_S and render.LAME_Q together. Done as pure recomputation from stored artefacts: the bead's literal 're-derive and re-score' would have rewritten the 181 files that ARE the baseline and spent a held-out shot already spent. What cannot be pinned without ffmpeg or a model host is named rather than faked.

classify.ENDPOINT is injected; ollama POSTs through ReachesModelEndpoint to {host}/api/generate; nothing in pipeline source hardcodes a host. Unanswered hosts raise ModelEndpointUnreachable naming the endpoint. HTTP 501 still retries unconstrained.
BindsModelEndpoint copies Configuration.model_endpoint onto classify.ENDPOINT; substituting SERMON_MODEL_ENDPOINT via ReadsConfiguration is the host classify.ollama POSTs to.
Removed unused speaker_edges assignment from derive(); speaker edges still influence snap via candidate_edges (already tested). Extraction follow-up, no Gherkin.
Hygiene guard walks the sermon package import graph instead of all of sys.modules; passes regardless of collection order.

ExtendsSegmentSpan refuses a span that would overlap a neighbour on the same Recording, with the scenario's reason; touching and other recordings do not block.

CorpusPair in the application store: one record per source/edit pair, unique on recording+classification+provenance. Exclusions, drift fits (ppm and intercept-as-punch-in) and machine-cut provenance are stored fields, not inferred from audio or frozen experiments. Review uniqueness hole fixed; TDD-ordering minor filed.

DOMAIN.md now matches the spec: no hard delete in v1, one analysis, local FLAC reclaim, hand-drawn Segments have no seed Block, and the publication label is suggested from the summary. Settled questions left the does-not-decide section; only storage engine remains.
Proposal punch_in_grade/punch_out_grade is the machine's grade of its own cut; CorpusPair punch_in_difficulty/punch_out_difficulty is the human-cut score a configuration cannot change.
Proposal punch_in_grade/punch_out_grade is the machine's grade of its own cut; CorpusPair punch_in_difficulty/punch_out_difficulty is the scored human-cut quantity a configuration cannot change.
enrolled_from names Segments (int segment_id FK). Un-enrolling one of a lesson+sermon on the same Recording leaves the other. Profile is created, Segment is created, then enrolled_from is updated.
Reviewer entity stores receives_notifications on the actor seam; SendsNotification honours it at send time. Opt-out does not hide recordings or stop Notification creation.

Integrity sample 2026-09-19 (mutation). 16 named samples; 1 implemented Gherkin scenario. WEAK: (1) Extending a Segment — sp-7us (anywhere-in-span pins 1:27:00), sp-dpd (success not stored); (2) overlap exception-only tests — sp-ncj (sibling persist HOLDS); (5) no-channel send — sp-fdr; (8) drift measured — sp-a8i; (10) cannot-be-aligned listed not excluded — sp-l5r; (14) Notification.kind open — sp-hmv. HOLDS: 3 opt-out send, 4 opt-out list, 6 enrolment Segment-grained UPDATE, 7 punch_in_grade UPDATE, 9 CorpusPair upsert UPDATE, 11 publication label DOMAIN, 12 Reviewer pref UPDATE, 13 CorpusPair unique identity, 15 enrolment refusal nothing stored, 16 grade vs difficulty isolation. Recurring; re-deferred.

First three-click-week scenario: POST /api/webhooks/recordings returns 202, stores a discovered Recording (id and started_at from the object key), queues a download Job, and treats host identity as optional. Acceptance derived from webhook_notification.feature Rule 'A valid webhook creates exactly one Recording'. Merged to tpett/ai/v1-build.

Second three-click-week Rule: DownloadsRecording fetches the FLAC, moves discovered through downloading to downloaded, notes sidecar_present, stores duration/sample_rate/channels from sidecar or probe, and queues an analyze Job (pinned on the missing-sidecar production path). started_at stays the parseable object key, not sidecar recorded_at or last-modified — Gherkin Scenario 3 last Then is inverted to match DOMAIN.md; do not treat last-modified as a sidecar-missing fallback. Merged to tpett/ai/v1-build.

Stubbed analyze Job runs Gherkin stage order, stores two Segments with punch-in/out/classification/confidence, Recording awaiting_review, notifies reviewers. Other orchestration Rules stay red. Acceptance derived from analysis_orchestration.feature Rule 'The pipeline runs its stages in dependency order'.
Preview in, preview out, approve queues a render Job for the easy-cut sermon Segment and does not open the waveform editor. Other segment_review Rules stay red.

Date defaults from the Recording and is stored with a label on the Segment. Stubbed processing run (extract/normalize/encode/name/publish) leaves the Segment complete and notifies the reviewer. No ffmpeg; pipeline untouched. Other publication/processing Rules stay red.

Worker runs queued download/analyze/render. Triggers enqueue and return immediately. Jobs survive restart without double-run. Duplicate analyze enqueue is a no-op. Health view, backoff, concurrency bound stay red.
GET /api/recordings lists recordings newest first, hides discarded, summarises segments, flags attention and analysis_failed. Search, filter outlines, and pagination stay red.
Recording detail, publication PUT, approve POST, and filename-from-date-and-label are green. End-to-end test covers webhook → download → analyze → list → approve → stubbed render.
Approving one and skipping the rest, and approving two, are green. Recording becomes reviewed when no Segment remains proposed. POST /api/segments/<id>/skip exists.
